The repo doesn't match yet: `main` (clean working tree) still has the `Makefile` and has no `justfile`. The removal may be on another branch or not pushed yet. Either way, the "fast" target is just a pytest marker filter, so this works directly:

```sh
pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

That skips the integration tests marked `postgres`, which need a real database. For the full suite (`pytest -q`, or `just test`), run `docker compose up db` first or the Postgres tests fail with connection errors.

If the new `justfile` doesn't have a fast recipe yet, this is the equivalent of the old `make test-fast`:

```just
test-fast:
    pytest -m "not postgres" -q

test:
    pytest -q
```

Then `just test-fast` does the job.
